folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID to list contents from. Defaults to "root" (the user's My Drive root) if not provided.

returns.description: Result object containing the list of files and folders found in the specified Google Drive folder

files.description: Array of file and folder metadata objects returned by the Google Drive API (pageSize: 100, excludes trashed items)

id.description: Google Drive file or folder ID

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file (e.g. application/vnd.google-apps.folder, image/png)

iconLink.description: URL of the file type icon provided by Google Drive

size.description: File size in bytes as a string (absent for Google Workspace files)

fileExtension.description: File extension without leading dot (absent for Google Workspace files)

webViewLink.description: URL to view the file in Google Drive web interface

webContentLink.description: Direct download URL for the file (absent for Google Workspace native formats)

errors.message: OAuth Token is invalid or expired. Please re-authenticate.
Failed to list Google Drive files.

import_file.doc: Import a single file from Google Drive

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the file to import. Can be obtained from list_files response (files[].id).

nid.description: Destination folder node ID in Drumee MFS where the imported file will be placed

returns.description: Result object containing the newly created Drumee MFS node for the imported file

node.description: The newly created MFS node object in Drumee representing the imported file, including nid, file_name, mimetype, and filesize

errors.message: This file type is not directly downloadable or exportable.
Failed to get Google file metadata.
OAuth Token is invalid or expired. Please re-authenticate.

import_directory.doc: Import entire directory recursively from Google Drive

folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID of the directory to import recursively. Can be obtained from list_files response (files[].id where mimeType is application/vnd.google-apps.folder).

nid.description: Destination folder node ID in Drumee MFS where the imported directory tree will be created

returns.description: Import statistics object summarising the recursive import operation

success.description: Always true when the operation completes (even if some files were skipped or had errors)

folders.description: Total number of folders created in Drumee MFS during the recursive import

files.description: Total number of files successfully imported from Google Drive

skipped.description: Number of files skipped because they are not downloadable or exportable (e.g. unsupported Google Workspace types)

errors.description: Array of per-file or per-item error objects for non-fatal failures encountered during the recursive import. Each entry contains file or item name and the error message.

errors.message: Failed to import directory due to a fatal error during the recursive import process.
